summary: Iron Horse Acquisition II Corp. (IRHO) entered into a definitive merger agreement on April 21, 2026, to acquire Electra Vehicles, Inc., a battery intelligence AI company, via a business combination. IRHO will domesticate from Cayman Islands to Delaware, then its wholly owned subsidiary Merger Sub will merge into Electra, making Electra the surviving wholly owned subsidiary, with both entities renamed. The IRHO board unanimously approved and recommends shareholder approval. Terms—price, value, premium, and share consideration—are not disclosed in this filing. The transaction is subject to IRHO shareholder approval and regulatory clearance. Watch for redemptions and the shareholder vote timeline as key risk-arb factors.
